articles.summary: Ever wished for seamless file syncing between your laptop and a remote server? With Mutagen, it's possible! Install Mutagen on your local machine, start syncing with a simple command, and monitor it effortlessly. Handle sync conflicts easily and customize syncing preferences using a config file for smoother workflow integration.
articles.title: Mutagen tutorial: syncing files easily with a remote server
